nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Index and overview document for the 'Addiction Features' Block B design docs, listing 7 engagement-loop features with cross-feature decisions, a ratification checklist, and recommended build order.

nodes.name: 01-memory-streak.md
nodes.summary: Feature design spec for the Memory Streak Counter — a daily engagement hook that tracks consecutive days of memory activity, with UI sketch, data model, acceptance criteria, and implementation notes.

nodes.name: 02-daily-brief.md
nodes.summary: Feature design spec for the Daily Brief Notification — a server-generated morning summary surfacing yesterday's memory highlights to drive daily re-engagement, with data model and generator details.

nodes.name: 03-continuity-banner.md
nodes.summary: Feature design spec for the Continuity Moments auto-resume banner — a UI surface that detects interrupted sessions and prompts users to pick up where they left off, with data model and acceptance criteria.

nodes.name: 04-weekly-wins-digest.md
nodes.summary: Feature design spec for the Weekly Memory Wins Digest — a server-generated weekly email/in-app summary surfacing the most impactful memories of the week to reinforce the memory value loop.

nodes.name: 05-milestone-cards.md
nodes.summary: Feature design spec for First-Time Milestone Cards — celebratory UI cards that fire on key user achievements (first memory saved, first week streak, etc.) to reinforce early habit formation.

nodes.name: 06-tour-replay.md
nodes.summary: Feature design spec for the Tour Replay Button — a persistent UI affordance letting users re-trigger the onboarding tour at any time to rediscover features, with data model and acceptance criteria.

nodes.name: 07-pending-imports-reminder.md
nodes.summary: Feature design spec for the Pending Imports Reminder Banner — a contextual prompt that detects when users have unused data sources awaiting import and nudges them to harvest more memory.
